Net Asset Value(s) | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings Login Register Net Asset Value(s) AI Summary Close X The Company reports net asset values at close of business on 24 November 2026 of 558.3p per share including current financial year revenue (debt at fair value 564.4p) and 555.9p per share excluding revenue (debt at fair value 562.0p). NAVs are calculated using AIC methodology; debt fair value reflects a discount rate based on UK gilt redemption yields plus credit spreads derived from ICE BofAML 1–3 and 15+ Year Non‑Gilt vs Gilt indices and is applied daily, with specific reference to the 4.53% 2029, 2.67% 2046 and 2.94% 2049 senior secured notes, which can influence NAV volatility.
